scope_note: Deployment wiring only. Measured: 0 files under apps/** or packages/** are changed by this lane, so no running service behaves differently. What changes is the order and failure handling of the production promotion sequence, and what deploy/rollback.sh restores.

incident_binding.what_failed: The promote step ran `docker compose up -d --remove-orphans` against a compose configuration that could not resolve, after the release markers had already been advanced. --remove-orphans reconciled the project and took caddy down; the public edge stayed down, and the host's .unit-talk-release named a release it had never started.
three_defects_closed: the Command Center env file was written from variables the step never mapped, producing empty values with no failure
the configuration error surfaced only from the mutating command, after it had already removed the edge
release markers were advanced before activation, so the host's own metadata could not describe what was running

order: on a failure whose text proves a port conflict: docker rm -f caddy, then retry exactly once
on any other failure, or a failed retry: restore_edge brings caddy back on the release the host still records, then exit 1
only on success: advance .unit-talk-release, then clear .unit-talk-deploy-inflight
port_conflict_signatures_matched: is already in use by container
promotion_transaction.marker_order_preserved_for_existing_gate: release advanced before inflight cleared, as deploy-config-rollback.test.ts already required
promotion_transaction.health_timeout_path: restores the edge before failing, and passes --command-center to rollback.sh when the Command Center is enabled

compose_validation.method: docker compose [--profile command-center] config --services over ssh, read-only
read_only_sites: canary job, immediately before the mutation step
promote job, immediately before the mutation step
compose_validation.mutating_site: promote job, inside the UNIT_TALK_COMMAND_CENTER_ENABLED guard
asserts: command-center is present when the profile is selected

rollback_repair.env_edge_reason: .env.edge carries the three hostnames Caddy needs to parse its own config, so a rollback that skipped it restored an edge configured by the release it was rolling away from
rollback_repair.command_center_absent_snapshot_behaviour: removed, not left in place -- a stale 0600 file holding the service-role key and an operator credential must not survive a rollback to a release that did not run the Command Center

static_gates.pnpm_verify_exit_reason: ci:assert-staging refuses outside the staging-ci GitHub environment by design; CI's required verify check is the binding authority

self_found_vacuities: M7 escaped first because a UTV2-1922 comment in the canary body quoted `docker compose up` ahead of the markers, so the ordering assertion's indexOf found the comment. Fixed by executableLines(), which strips comment lines before every ordering assertion.

M9 escaped first because the behavioural test was vacuous: in parse-fail mode nothing removed caddy, so the edge read as served for free. Fixed by making the stub remove caddy in that mode and asserting the script's own 'edge preserved' output.
detail: drop CC_ENABLED from the env: mapping -> 'every Command Center value the env file interpolates is mapped into the step'
remove the fail-closed required-value loop -> 'an empty required Command Center value refuses the write'
disabled branch stops removing .env.command-center -> 'a disabled Command Center leaves no configuration behind'
promote job loses its preflight validation step -> 'compose configuration is validated before anything destructive runs'
validation step moved after the mutation step -> same assertion
promote advances .unit-talk-release before activation -> 'no mutation step advances the release markers before activation'
canary advances markers before activation -> same assertion, via executableLines()
caddy removed unconditionally rather than on a proven conflict -> 'the edge is removed only on a proven port conflict'
generic failure path no longer calls restore_edge -> 'a configuration failure cannot leave the edge unserved' (behavioural, docker stub)
rollback.sh drops .env.edge from the restore loop -> 'rollback restores every env file the running stack reads'
rollback.sh advances the release record before activation -> 'rollback advances the release record only after activation'

behavioural_execution.method: the real PROMOTE_REMOTE heredoc is extracted from .github/workflows/deploy.yml and executed against a bash docker stub in a temporary directory
cases: a successful promotion advances both markers and never touches the edge
a configuration failure cannot leave the edge unserved
a failed activation leaves release metadata describing reality
a genuine port conflict is still recovered
a port conflict whose retry fails still restores the edge
behavioural_execution.non_vacuity_control: the extracted body is asserted non-empty and to contain docker compose, .unit-talk-release, .unit-talk-deploy-inflight and restore_edge, and the harness is shown able to observe a successful advance

scope_expansion.form: one exact path, deliberately not a deploy/** glob
scope_expansion.justification: promotion calls rollback as its recovery path, so the two halves are one transaction and cannot be repaired in separate lanes

required_operator_inputs: a Deploy dispatch (reserved decision 8) is the only way to exercise this change in production
reserved_not_taken.non_secret_success_criterion: on the next Deploy dispatch, the promote job logs 'resolving compose configuration for tag <sha>' and the step succeeds before any mutation runs; on a failure, the job logs 'edge preserved' and the host's .unit-talk-release still names the previously running release
